zh: 每次操作都是从前三项里删两项、留一项；所以第一次操作之后，队列总能描述成“一个被留下的值 + 尚未处理的原数组后缀”。
用字典 dp 记录“当前留在队首的值 → 到达此状态的最小花费”。每轮把留下的值和接下来两项放在一起，枚举三者中留下哪一个，另外两个的较大值就是这一步的花费；同一保留值只保留更小的花费。

n<3 时答案就是最大值。否则先处理 a[0..2] 得到初始 dp；然后每次取 p=a[i]、q=a[i+1]，对每个 (carry,cost) 生成三种转移 (carry,cost+max(p,q))、(p,cost+max(carry,q))、(q,cost+max(carry,p))，i+=2。结束时若还剩一项 a[i]，答案为 min(cost+max(carry,a[i]))，否则为 min(cost+carry)。
en: Every operation deletes two of the first three items and keeps one, so after the first operation the queue can always be described as one kept value plus an unprocessed suffix of the original array.

Keep a map dp from the value kept at the front to the least cost of reaching that state. Each round, put the kept value together with the next two items, enumerate which of the three stays, and pay the larger of the other two; for the same kept value keep only the smaller cost.

If n < 3 the answer is the maximum. Otherwise process a[0..2] for the initial dp. Then repeatedly take p = a[i], q = a[i+1] and, for each (carry, cost), produce (carry, cost + max(p, q)), (p, cost + max(carry, q)) and (q, cost + max(carry, p)); advance i by 2. At the end, if one item a[i] remains, the answer is min(cost + max(carry, a[i])), otherwise min(cost + carry).

explanationEn:
## Approach

After the first three items are processed, exactly one item remains. Use dynamic programming that records "value kept at the front of the queue -> least cost paid to reach that state". Each round, consider that value together with the next two items and enumerate which one stays; at the end, when fewer than three items are left, settle them all at once as the statement says.

## Proof of correctness

Every operation deletes two items from the first three, so after an operation the queue is uniquely represented by one kept value and an unprocessed suffix. The transition enumerates the single element left among the first three and pays the maximum of the other two, as the statement requires, so it covers every possible operation without omission. Keeping only the lower cost for the same kept value does not affect future choices, so this state compression preserves optimality. Finally settling according to the fewer-than-three rule and taking the minimum gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

Let n be the array length: at most n states and at most n/2 rounds, so O(n^2) time and O(n) space.
